name: Pharaoh Nidalee Custom SFX
creator: lolsfxamateur
description:
Custom SFX for Pharaoh Nidalee. Contains version with live VO and old VO.
Using this mod will overwrite SFX for all skins that use the base SFX. In other words, these SFX will play even using a different skin such as French Maid Nidalee.
